131.name: STACK: 4+ separate facts on one side
131.rule: 4 or more SEPARATE reasons on the same side, each counted once: the players model 3+ (in every version of tonight), card systems, a tired opponent (back-to-back / overtime / rest and the systems built on them), injuries (X2-X4), a 25+ blowout win, the other team leaning on unknown players, shooting luck. Only facts known before the line moves. 2 seasons at the opening line: 136-75 (64.5%). Every fact is listed on the bet. Sized to win $40 (2 units).

132.name: SYS+X4: a system + fading a team missing 2+ players at different positions
